title: Concurrent users, streaming
description: one new reading every 300ms · window of 50 · click to restart

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered sample labels and nonnegative finite active-user counts in thousands. Invalid values create gaps; an unavailable final sample does not borrow a previous current value.

props.name: sourceStatus
props.description: Caller-owned static status badge. The chart never fetches or generates live observations.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
